g.title: TF_EVENT_DEFINITIONS
g.text: Main Entity the Notification refers to.
The datasource field that specifies the users that are eligible to be recipient of the notification.
The rule that specifies the users that are eligible to be recipient of the notification. The rule must be compliant with the event datasource.
Important (notification marked as important until subscriber set as Read).
The Security Check for each User.

g.title: TF_USERS
g.text: Indicates if the API are enabled for the user.
Indicates whether the Two Factor Authentication is enabled
Indicates whether the Two Factor Authentication is forced
The Two Factor Authentication Activation date
The start date used to calculate the deadline for each user to complete the 2FA setup.
Indicates the date of last time the user logon the system by the two factor authentication.
With this option activated, the user can no longer be activated . All tasks / logs / activities this user was linked to will continue to be logged like that
Date and time (Utc) when the user interactively accessed the system
The identifier of the client from where the user accessed the last time

g.title: TF_PROFILE_CATALOG
g.text: When turned off, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can impersonate any active user. When turned on, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can only impersonate active users included in the specified set
A set used to limit the list of users that is possible to impersonate using the proxy logon feature.
This profile is exclude from automatical assignment of default profiles.
